name: discrepancy-lollipops
title: Discrepancy lollipops
description: Lollipop plot of percentage difference against a tolerance band, trailing stems to zero for breaks.
needs: A numeric measure and percentage tolerance.

text.title: {left} against {right}
text.lede: Each {unitOne} is a dot on one scale of percentage difference. Inside the tolerance band is normal. A dot outside trails a stem back to zero in the colour of the side that is higher.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: Row order: largest percentage difference first, or as sent.

options.name: maxRows
options.description: Draw at most this many records.
